why do we have the inline pointer events none?

> why do we have the inline pointer events none?

I'm defining the width and height of the chat on the `.ais-Chat` class (which wraps the toggle button), and I'm setting `pointer-events` to `none` on it so that you can interact with the content below the chat. I'm also setting `pointer-events` to `auto` on the chat itself and the toggle button.
